System

Water casts, bobber, bite, reel and catch transaction

Fishing is a server-owned timed attempt at an eligible water region. The rod overlay and bobber visualize casting/waiting/bite/reel states; neither a notify nor a delayed packet can create a second catch.

Scope and player interaction

Fishing is a server-owned timed attempt at an eligible water region. The rod overlay and bobber visualize casting/waiting/bite/reel states; neither a notify nor a delayed packet can create a second catch.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase14committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Idle → Aiming → Casting → Waiting → BiteWindow → Reeling → CommitPending → Caught → Failed → Canceled

WBP_Fishing observes results from URPGFishingComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_FishingPool_Rillmere. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
FishingAttemptId UUID; CharacterId/session epoch; WaterBodyId and pool version
CastPointCm: finite bounded point inside approved water polygon/volume
BobberPosition: accepted world-space point, not attached to screen or character
BiteStartServerSeconds and BiteEndServerSeconds: server timing, secret until relevant cue
ReelSequenceId: one accepted reaction per attempt
ResolvedSpeciesId/Quantity/ProfessionXP: stored terminal result, not rerolled on UI open
TerminalState: Caught|Failed|Canceled; one terminal receipt per attempt

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGFishingComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_FishingLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
RequestFishingCast(CommandId, WaterBodyId, AimPoint) -> AttemptStarted|WrongTool|InvalidWater|TooFar
RequestReel(AttemptId, InputSequence) -> Accepted|TooEarly|TooLate|AlreadyResolved
CancelFishing(AttemptId, Reason) -> Canceled|AlreadyTerminal
ResolveFishingAttempt(AttemptId, ApprovedOutcome) -> Receipt|AlreadyResolved; server/backend

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Player equips/owns a FishingRod and aims from reachable shoreline. Server verifies water ID, pool, range, LOS, dry/shore policy and action state.
  2. Create one attempt and accepted cast point; replicate cosmetic cast/bobber state. p3 rod poses must match body/outfit pages after actual source inspection.
  3. Server chooses an auditable wait/bite schedule and opens the reaction window on its own clock; clients show cues using replicated accepted times.
  4. Player reels. Server validates the active attempt, current actor/session, one unused input sequence and receipt time within the allowed reaction policy; client claimed timestamps are not blindly trusted.
  5. On success select species from the approved biome pool and enabled weather/time modifiers, then atomically store terminal result, grant fish/profession XP and applicable rod durability cost with inventory capacity checks.
  6. UI/audio play from committed result and destroy the bobber. Late notifies/reel packets return AlreadyResolved and cannot grant fish.
  7. Disconnect/restart before terminal commit cancels unresolved attempt under lease-recovery policy; committed catch remains in inventory on reconnect. Never resume an old bite window into a new session.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create BP_WaterRegion with Water_Rill, surface bounds and DA_FishingPool_Rillmere. Mark a reachable ShoreSpot_A and validate cast-point traces against real water/terrain.
  2. Create BP_FishingBobber as a nonauthoritative visual representation of accepted attempt/point, with one owner/action association and explicit teardown.
  3. Create DA_FishingPool_Rillmere with RiverDace/Mudfin weights and a small no-catch/failure policy; species are item definitions with separate text/icons/art tasks.
  4. Add URPGFishingComponent and WBP_Fishing progress/reaction UI. Use IA_Primary/IA_FishReel or an explicit context mapping, not a second global click handler that also attacks.
  5. Reopen item tool validation, inventory/profession transaction, water/swimming cancellation and PaperZD action mapping. Missing p3 clothing uses a declared compatible fallback.
  6. Run replay, early/late reel, full-bag, movement-cancel, rod-swap, disconnect and server-restart fixtures with Client_B observing the bobber but not private loot details.

Reopen Phase14 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / Water_Rill / ShoreSpot_A / Bobber_A. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Reel before bite -> TooEarly under chosen fail-or-continue policy; no fish.
Late/replayed reel after Caught -> AlreadyResolved, unchanged inventory.
Full bag at terminal commit -> NoSpace, no fish or profession XP; attempt fails terminally rather than waiting indefinitely for a free slot.
Move/swim/unequip rod -> Canceled; bobber removed on all relevant clients.
Server dies during Waiting/BiteWindow -> unresolved attempt canceled on recovery; no automatic catch.
Commit acknowledgement lost -> receipt restores original fish once, even in another zone.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Proposed cast range 1200 cm, wait 3–8 s, reaction window 1.5 s, one fish and 5 fishing XP. Accessibility can offer longer authored reaction windows consistently validated server-side; no client-only timing advantage.

Track attempt transitions, server reaction latency, terminal result and pool version. Bite cue uses text/visual/audio, with audio optional. Weather/time modifiers are disabled until shared world-state versioning is implemented.
